title: A Nemzeti dal (The Nemzeti Dal)
grammar: Adverbial Participles, Rhetorical Imperatives & National Symbols Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say what the Nemzeti dal is and when Petőfi recited it.
I can quote the first line and the oath of the Nemzeti dal.
I can say how the Nemzeti dal spread on 15 March 1848 and why people still recite it.
I can use six new words about the Nemzeti dal, such as eskü and felhívás.
